# Availability

A time-scoped statement of an agent's availability over an interval — free, busy, tentative, or out-of-office. The free-busy spine of the calendar layer.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Availability>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:Availability`  

**Type:** `gufo:SituationType`, `owl:Class`  

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/calendar>
